name: renewtube
description: Flips youtube.com into a clean, simple player for both music and video: search, feeds, queue and playlist management over YouTube's own player.
author: OpenCourse

scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../renewtube.zip . && cd .. && echo 'renewtube.zip'
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/build-lab.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/build-lab.mjs && playwright test
scripts.shots: npm run build && SHOT_DIR=site npx playwright test --config=playwright.tools.ts shots
